title: 冬至・ゆず湯のイラスト
subject_en: Winter solstice (toji) customs and foods, each a separate object, kawaii soft style, warm yellow and orange palette. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters.
lead: 冬至の行事に関わる食べ物や場面をまとめた12点の素材です。給食だより、保健だより、施設掲示に使えます。
items: three yellow yuzu citrus fruits with leaves
a wooden tub with hot water, floating yuzu and gentle steam
a whole kabocha squash with a cut half showing seeds
a small bowl of simmered kabocha pieces
a bowl of red-bean porridge with steam
a pair of konnyaku blocks on a small plate
a small low sun over a hill with long shadows, winter mood
a crescent moon and stars over a quiet house
a folded towel with a small yellow rubber duck
a cosy kotatsu table with a quilt and a tangerine
a tray with a kabocha slice, a carrot, a ginkgo nut, a kumquat and a bowl of udon noodles, simply drawn
a knitted scarf, mittens and a hat arranged together
